text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8421 fired for synthetic check 'eu-edge-canary' — failure rate 27% over 5m, latency > 1200ms for 15% of probes. Region: eu-west-1. Severity: P3. Link: https://pd.example/PD-8421 :rotating_light:

Erin: Acked. I'm oncall. I'll take lead. What's the current customer impact?

Alex W: seeing increased 5xxs from canary targets in eu-west-1, but prod traffic unaffected so far. Some internal routing tests failing. Logs show 502 from upstream cache.

Maria G: alert dashboard: canary error rate started at 12:31UTC and jumped at 12:36UTC. Spike correlates with cache ttl eviction job at 12:30.

Erin: ok disabling the canary rollout to stop synthetic traffic, will also scale down canary pool to 0.

oncall-rotation: pagerduty: auto-escalation to oncall after 2m, Erin acknowledged at 12:39UTC.

Erin: running command to cordon canary nodes and remove canary label
```bash
kubectl get nodes -l node-role.kubernetes.io/canary -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
kubectl delete deployment eu-edge-canary -n redwood-canaries
```

Alex W: logs from canary pods show repeated 502 from cache-service: "upstream request failed: connection reset"

Maria G: traffic router shows no fallthrough to prod models. Canary probe only. customer-facing SLA unaffected.

Joe (CS): I'm on standby; if customers ask, we should say: "No customer-facing errors observed; internal synthetic checks triggered an alert. We're mitigating." Keep me updated.

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: Incident assigned to Erin. SLA: P3. Notifications sent to on-call and eng-runtime.

Erin: scaled down canary replicas to 0, and temporarily disabled canary routing rule in envoy. Monitoring now shows error rate dropping back to baseline over two probe cycles.

Alex W: confirmed. error rate dropped to 1.2% at 12:52UTC. Latency p95 returned to normal.

Erin: root-cause hypothesis: scheduled cache-ttl purge job evicted a large fraction causing upstream 502s under warmup. I put a mitigation: stagger TTL purge and added backpressure limiter to cache-service rollout.

Maria G: creating a follow-up ticket for permanent fix and PM sync. tagging infra and cache teams.

Erin: current status: mitigated, canary disabled, no customer impact. Will do handoff to next oncall in 20m. Postmortem and timeline will be written.

Joe (CS): thanks — I'll draft a brief internal blurb for CSMs: short summary + what to tell customers if they ask.

Erin: handing off to Alex W for next oncall in 20m. I'll add notes in the incident doc. Closing the active paging. :white_check_mark:

Alex W: taking next handoff. I'll watch the metric dashboards for next 2 hours and follow up on the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8421 resolved. Duration: ~23m. Postmortem: https://docs.internal/incidents/PD-8421
